name: village-third-person
expression: async()=>{window.measureWalk=async(x,z)=>{const r=Realm.test.move(x,z);if(!r.ok)throw Error(r.error);const t=performance.now();while(Realm.test.path.length){if(performance.now()-t>45000)throw Error('Walk timeout');await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,50));}return {...Realm.diagnostics.adventure.player};};window.measureCommand=(type,payload={})=>{const r=Realm.test.adventure('frame-sample-'+type+'-'+performance.now(),type,payload);if(!r.ok)throw Error(r.error);return r;};await measureWalk(11,9);measureCommand('class-choose',{id:'hunter',confirm:true});document.querySelector('[data-rpg="camera"][data-id="adventure"]').click();return {class:Realm.state.adventure.classPath.choice,player:Realm.diagnostics.adventure.player};}
